name: wealth_convert
q: SELECT CONVERT(SUM(position), 'EUR') as total WHERE account ~ 'Assets:' AND NOT account ~ 'Assets:RealEstate'

name: balances_by_account
q: SELECT account, CONVERT(SUM(position), 'EUR') as balance WHERE account ~ 'Assets:' GROUP BY account ORDER BY account

name: count_star
q: SELECT COUNT(*) as n WHERE account ~ 'Expenses:'

name: count_star_tags_exclude
q: SELECT COUNT(*) as n WHERE account ~ 'Expenses:' AND NOT "exclude" IN tags

name: order_by_per_term
q: SELECT root(account, 2) as acct, year(date) as y, CONVERT(SUM(position), 'EUR') as v WHERE account ~ 'Expenses:' AND NOT "exclude" IN tags GROUP BY acct, y ORDER BY y, v DESC

name: order_mixed_dir
q: SELECT account, number WHERE account ~ 'Assets' AND number != 0 ORDER BY account ASC, number DESC

name: yearmonth_group
q: SELECT yearmonth(date) as ym, CONVERT(SUM(position), 'EUR') as v WHERE account ~ 'Expenses:' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym DESC

name: open_meta_buckets
q: SELECT getitem(open_meta(account), 'bucket') as bucket, CONVERT(SUM(position), 'EUR') as amt WHERE account ~ 'Assets:' GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

name: stock_positions
q: SELECT account, currency(units(position)) as ticker, number(units(position)) as shares, number(cost(position)) as cost_basis WHERE account ~ 'Stocks' ORDER BY account

name: income_year_month
q: SELECT year, month, CONVERT(SUM(position), 'EUR') as v WHERE account ~ 'Income' GROUP BY year, month ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC

name: convert_at_date
q: SELECT CONVERT(SUM(position), 'EUR', 2023-06-30) as total WHERE account ~ 'Assets:Bank'

name: recent_expenses
q: SELECT payee, CONVERT(position, 'EUR') as amount WHERE account ~ 'Expenses:' ORDER BY date
